location: solution.py:train_step — the .item()-dependent Python branch forces a dynamo graph break, and build_model compiles without dynamic-shape support
why: The .item() call reads a scalar to CPU, synchronizing the host and preventing dynamo from compiling a single graph. Combined with 8 different batch sizes in the measurement loop, this causes repeated recompilation of the compiled model, wasting the compile budget on every new shape.
